name: Wandering Shell
description: Boxes armored with a 3-HP steel shell that jumps to a new box each time it takes damage.
howToPlay: Tap boxes adjacent to the Shell to deal damage. After each hit the Shell leaps to a random new box — hunt it down and hit it 3 times to shatter it and free the box underneath.
author: Claude

showcaseLevel.name: Wandering Shell Demo
showcaseLevel.desc: Chase the armored shell across the grid!
